formulas.label: Days Until or Since a Date
formulas.explanation: Return a signed date difference relative to today using an explicit direction.

fields.label: Date
fields.help: Enter a date as YYYY-MM-DD, or choose a date-only cell in this row.

fields.label: Direction
fields.help: until subtracts today from the date; since subtracts the date from today. Results keep their sign.

formulas.label: Days Between Two Dates
formulas.explanation: Subtract the start date from the end date, preserving the sign.

fields.label: Start date
fields.help: Enter a date as YYYY-MM-DD, or choose a date-only cell in this row.

fields.label: End date
fields.help: Enter a date as YYYY-MM-DD, or choose a date-only cell in this row. The result is End date minus Start date and can be negative.

formulas.label: WORKDAY
formulas.explanation: Shift a date by whole working days using native WORKDAY and optional holiday dates.

fields.label: Start date
fields.help: Enter a date as YYYY-MM-DD, or choose a date-only cell in this row.

fields.label: Working days offset
fields.help: Enter whole working days: positive, negative or zero. Native function limits and result-date overflow can still produce an error.

fields.label: Holiday dates
fields.help: Choose one date column. For a current-sheet range use the same start and end column. A named reference must represent one column; its dimensions and contents cannot be checked here.

formulas.label: Flag Overdue Rows
formulas.explanation: Flag a past-due row, optionally suppressing rows completed by a checkbox or one configured status value.

fields.label: Due date
fields.help: Choose a date-only due-date cell in this row.

fields.label: Completion check
fields.help: Optional: suppress the flag using a completion checkbox or one status value. No source column or completion value is inferred.

fields.label: Completion text
fields.help: Enter the one status value that means complete. No value is supplied automatically.

formulas.label: NETWORKDAYS
formulas.explanation: Call native NETWORKDAYS with the supplied start and end dates and optional holidays.

fields.label: Start date
fields.help: Enter a date as YYYY-MM-DD, or choose a date-only cell in this row.

fields.label: End date
fields.help: Enter a date as YYYY-MM-DD, or choose a date-only cell in this row. Passed as the second NETWORKDAYS argument.

fields.label: Holiday dates
fields.help: Choose one date column. For a current-sheet range use the same start and end column. A named reference must represent one column; its dimensions and contents cannot be checked here.

formulas.label: NETDAYS
formulas.explanation: Call native NETDAYS with the supplied dates without endpoint or sign adjustments.

fields.label: Start date
fields.help: Enter a date as YYYY-MM-DD, or choose a date-only cell in this row.

fields.label: End date
fields.help: Enter a date as YYYY-MM-DD, or choose a date-only cell in this row. Passed as the second NETDAYS argument; this is not the subtraction template.
